description: Walk a wiki's tree: every page you can see, parent before child, with its `path`, its `state` and its `depth`. Use it to find where a page belongs before creating one, and to get the paths the other wiki tools address pages by. A page you cannot see is not listed, so the tree never offers a route that fails.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

wiki.description: wiki is the wiki to walk - its id or its slug.

name: list_pages

parent.description: parent is the id of the page above it; empty for the wiki's root.

path.description: path is the page's full path within its wiki, e.g. "handbook/day-one".

restricted.description:
restricted is true when this page sits in a subtree that is fenced off to
 named people - you can see it, so you are one of them.

state.description:
state is one of: draft, awaiting_approval, published,
 published_draft_changes, archived, deletion_scheduled.

title: List pages
